acquisition_semantics.alias_is_the_only_rename: a raw/provider spelling becomes a canonical PIT ticker only through the explicit alias map; nothing is fuzzy-matched and a name the map declares not-aliased is never renamed
acquisition_semantics.collision_refuses: a canonical name arriving from two raw lane files refuses the day rather than merging two disagreeing sources
acquisition_semantics.denial_note: acquisition provenance is BOOKKEEPING about which raw files a row was read from, in the provenance/coverage namespaces already allowed above; it is not a value, not a quote feature, and never a prospective channel
acquisition_semantics.net_status_is_measured: net_manifest_status comes from the validated per-day manifests and the derived index, refined by the verified reconciliation; it is never a hardcoded pair of dates
acquisition_semantics.no_fabrication: an absent or incomplete acquisition day is not admitted and the baseline lane is used; no bar, zero price or roster row is ever invented to close a hole
acquisition_semantics.verified_absent_is_a_market_fact: a PIT name the acquisition verified did not trade (zero bars / no RTH / invalid symbol) is not an observation gap and never enters raw_roster_missing; an unclassified absent name remains one

allowed_namespaces.audit_coordinate: month, block, feed_era, dow, canary flags - split/audit coordinates only, never distance channels
allowed_namespaces.calendar: session_end, is_early_close - known ex ante from phase2_session_calendar.json
allowed_namespaces.coverage: coverage classes, counters, missingness blame, blockers - including the split between a PIT name VERIFIED absent by the acquisition (a market fact) and a PIT name that is a genuine missing confirmed trader
allowed_namespaces.key: identity/sort keys (day, ticker, family, entry_et, entry_rank, et, t, T, symbol, source_row_ordinal, member_id, path_id)
allowed_namespaces.print: print projection fields and print_state counters
allowed_namespaces.provenance: source paths, sha256 hashes, parser/rule ids, and the full raw-lane provenance of a row: the raw source kind(s) that supplied it, the COMBINED lane-set digest covering every contributing raw file plus the explicit alias map (never a bare single-file sha, so a two-lane supplement day is verifiable and drift on any contributing lane is caught), the acquisition scope/baseline standing/asof, the admitted acquisition manifest sha, the alias map sha, and which lane supplied the previous close
allowed_namespaces.quality: quality flags and provider-vs-SIP audit ratios (retrospective)
allowed_namespaces.race: population definitions, competition ranks, order_slot, counts
allowed_namespaces.roster: prospective roster membership and selectable_asof_et columns
allowed_namespaces.state_price: px, px_et, age_min, prev_close and its provenance, gain
allowed_namespaces.tape: bar OHLCV, bar_state, print rows (ts, price, size, exchange, conditions, tape, trade_id)

blocked_families.reason: panel outcome; describes the path after t
whole-ticket constants known only at the close

blocked_families.prospective_use: forbidden; may appear only as retrospective_only audit columns with prospective_allowed=false
blocked_families.reason: leaks the whole day or future-selected membership; retrospective only

storage headroom (B5) and missing net manifest days (B6) are coverage states, never market features; B3_quote_lane is the same kind of state and additionally gates the prospective quote channel (quote_channel_ready) without ever gating the core-bar/print/race build

blocked_families.provenance_exception: a quote_ name is legal only when schema.json declares it with a provenance namespace (key/roster/provenance/coverage/audit_coordinate) for the core quote ROSTER table; roster provenance/counts describe the roster ARTIFACT, never quote alpha, and no prefix guard may reject them
blocked_families.reason: the quote channel is a versioned sibling: no prospective quote feature may be materialized until causal quote acquisition (B3_quote_lane) passes, the registry value/absence vocabulary and any undeclared quote_ name are denied on write, and a null/missing quote for a causal-roster name is 'not acquired', never market information

derived_from_panel_registry.rule: the producer loads this registry at build time and asserts every per-day payload BEFORE write

explicitly_allowed_exceptions.mfe_so_far: causal running MFE from the member's state; allowed only as state, never as a future statistic
explicitly_allowed_exceptions.o570: allowed from T=571 onward (the 09:30 bar closes at 571); at T=570 the A_open snapshot is not yet selectable
explicitly_allowed_exceptions.px_T: causal at T (close of the last completed bar et<=T-1); its et travels in px_T_et
explicitly_allowed_exceptions.row_present/in_universe_file: row presence is not a prospective feature (plan 4.2)

leakage_negative_controls.rule: a frame containing any denied column must fail loudly before write
a retrospective_only column with prospective_allowed=true must fail validation
winners_open/winners_prev/net must never enter a prospective roster table
known_by_t=false must carry null price/gain/rank, never a forward-filled future value

physical_separation.enforcement: the producer builds every observation frame from an explicit column allowlist and asserts the written parquet schema contains no denied column name
physical_separation.rule: observation tables physically exclude outcome_*, ticket_constant, future_meta and censor columns; the exclusion is enforced by construction and by a post-write physical schema audit

policy: positive allowlist with default deny; a column is readable only if it is declared here or in schema.json with matching flags

resource_and_resume.bounded_vintage_cache: the per-vintage PIT frozenset cache is hard-bounded; the day registry uses a count-only path, so walking the dev calendar cannot grow the resident set
resource_and_resume.built_is_not_canary: `built` records what this stage produced; `canary_member` records the frozen selection. They are different facts and neither substitutes for the other
resource_and_resume.lane_digest_not_file_digest: the recorded raw-lane provenance is the combined lane-set digest, so verifying it means recomputing that same quantity over the same lane set
resource_and_resume.parent_resident_set_is_subtracted: the producer's own resident set is measured and subtracted from the soft RSS budget before workers are sized, and costs.json records the effective (not requested) worker count
resource_and_resume.resume_credit_must_rehash: a crashed run's per-day progress earns disk credit only for payloads whose bytes re-hash to the recorded sha256; absent or mismatched payloads earn nothing

row_level_gate: roster selectability is checked before column access: a row's selectable_asof_et must be <= the decision instant; whole-day and censor fields are retrospective only
